says: In next/, a law written with StartsTest.law runs a fixed 100 cases that sit inside next/packages/libfabrika/src/settings/StartsTest.ts, so the lint rule fabrika/runs-from-depth cannot see the count, and a law over real IO that calls it breaks decision 0535: 'L4 child grants pass through the recorded start to ChildrenLedger without entering ledger entries or receipts' still runs 100 cases at every depth.
proof: At origin/main, StartsTest.ts line 21 built its parameters as { numRuns: 100, ...examples }, and runtime.laws.integration.test.ts line 435 calls StartsTest.law over a world that opens node:sqlite, which the rule counts as real IO (oxlint-plugins/runs-from-depth.test.ts, OPENS). pnpm lint passes on both files. T753 L16 in runtime-recovery.laws.integration.test.ts had the same gap and took 58.8 s of its 60 s limit on scheduled run 43823291196, leg tests (4); the pull request for that finding fixes only L16.
cost: A heavy law over real IO runs its full count in a cloud box or a branch proof run, where fast depth should cut it, and can time out on a slow machine as T753 L16 did.
